habits.boundary_condition: Treat this as a preference rather than an absolute requirement unless the user explicitly says no layovers for the current trip.
habits.condition: When searching for outbound or return flights, prioritize nonstop options.
habits.default_action: Search for and present a nonstop itinerary first.
habits.exception_condition: If no suitable nonstop flight is available, a one-stop option may be acceptable, but confirm the tradeoff before booking.
habits.name: Prefer nonstop flights
habits.rationale: Across three independent flight requests, the user asks for nonstop service. Two dialogues also show that one stop can be accepted when a nonstop option is unavailable or when stated as the maximum.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly supports prioritizing nonstop flights, including for a return itinerary.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Just leave in the morning and no layovers non-stop.

source_evidence.contribution: Directly states the nonstop preference; later acceptance of the offered one-stop flight shows it can be relaxed when nonstop is unavailable.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: Economy and I'd like to have a non-stop flight.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports nonstop as the default and explicitly bounds the acceptable fallback at one stop.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like a non-stop flight or if at the most one stop in coach.
